name: voice-agent-config-generator
description: Build and test CloudTalk VoiceAgents from a plain-language brief.

api_key.title: CloudTalk API key (base64)
api_key.description: Optional — leave empty to use the plugin offline. Paste the base64 of API_KEY_ID:API_KEY_SECRET from Dashboard > Account > Settings > API keys; build it with: echo -n "API_KEY_ID:API_KEY_SECRET" | base64
